scope: Proposition 8.1 (Pending-site bound) of the manuscript “Absolutely Continuous Spectrum for Weak-Disorder Anderson Models in Dimensions at Least Three” (preprints/Absolutely-Continuous-Spectrum-for-Weak-Disorder-Anderson-Models-in-Dimensions-at-Least-Three-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 261 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0d971c56f6ba1641), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 80. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a constant ch > 0 such that, after increasing the fixed lower cutoff n0 if necessary, for every n0 ≤ j ≤ ⌊m/2⌋ and every torus site x, P(x is pending at the end of stage j) ≤ exp(−4chj ). All constants are uniform in m, E, λ in the stated ranges.
